basicDetails.schemeName: Interest Subsidy Scheme on Education Loan

children.text: The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat.
The applicant must be a student.
The applicant must have passed HSC (Higher Secondary Certificate) with at least 60 percentile.
The applicant must have taken an education loan from a recognized bank for pursuing higher education in India or abroad.
The applicant must have a family income not exceeding ₹6,00,000/- per year.

schemeContent.benefits_md: - **Interest Subsidy Assistance:** 100% interest subsidy on education loans up to ₹10,00,000/- for the moratorium period (course duration + 1 year).
schemeContent.briefDescription: The scheme "Interest Subsidy Scheme on Education Loan" by the Education Department, Gujarat, aims to provide financial support to students by offering 100% interest subsidy on education loans.

children.text: The scheme "Interest Subsidy Scheme on Education Loan" by the Education Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to provide complete financial relief to students through 100% interest subsidy on education loans for the entire moratorium period. This includes the study period and 1 additional year after course completion.
